verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no mention of Babylon.js's license (Apache 2.0), royalty terms, or revenue-sharing policy anywhere in the docs or community citations. Licensing is a fair and common axis for a game engine, but nothing here confirms or describes it, so this cannot be credited as delivered. Missing for 10: explicit license text/type, confirmation of no royalties/fees, any community or legal discussion of licensing terms.
